description: In ed3 mode the wait after the node's own transmission is the one common LBT value, lbt_wait_dcd_ms, where jitter mode would use lbt_wait_vdcd_ms; contention is jitter.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for non-ARQ (service type tx_mode 2, no confirmation) and gets S_BIND_ACCEPTED with MTU 2048 (A-0041, A-0047). Each S_UNIDATA_REQUEST is to SAP 5, DELIVERY MODE default, TTL 0 (the 648000-unit default, so TTD = request time + 1296000000 ms, A-0089, A-0091), and asks for no confirmation, so it produces no SIS output (A-0095). The CAS wraps the DATA S_PDU (priority, SAP 5 to SAP 5, TTD) in a DATA C_PDU (B-0297). Each D_PDU is type 7 NON-ARQ-DATA (C-0323, C-0575) with EOW 0, EMPTY (C-0398), address size 4, source 0.0.1.2, the whole C_PDU as its one segment (offset 0, C_PDU size = segment size, C-0343, C-0346), DELIVER IN ORDER clear (C-0333), C_PDU IDs allocated from 0 in placement order (C-0326, C-1040), and no pre-fill (D-0003). The air start of a D_PDU is the start of the block holding its first byte, preamble_ms + block x block_ms (C-1043); EOT = ceil((duration_ms - air start) / 500) (C-0104, C-0891, D-0005, D-0017), and the reception window is the same value because every copy of the C_PDU is in this transmission (C-0350, C-0352). The waveform is drc.default_speed, wn 2 long (C-0894). Ed3 settings per the K-0107 ruling: jitter contention, one common LBT value (lbt_wait_dcd_ms, here 20000), LBT rule 1 off. Seed 0 draws uniform(16) = 15 then 4: 45000 ms then 12000 ms. The second request arrives during LINKING and waits. At 70550 our own transmission ends; in jitter mode that VDCD-determined idle would give lbt_wait_vdcd_ms, 3000 (K-0074), but ed3 has only the common value, 20000. Jitter has no own-last-transmission rule (K-0085). The second C_PDU takes ID 1. Each transmission is one block, duration 5550 ms. Since corpus 0.7.0 the DTS also keeps dts.ttd at the earliest TTD in its transmit queue: started when a request becomes the earliest, cancelled when the transmit queue empties (C-1050).
